purpose: PV-11 (#327) explicit test mapping for frozen scenarios whose tests do not carry the scenario ID. Every other case maps to tests whose names contain its ID. A mapping records candidate coverage only; the gate report states which expected outcomes each mapped test proves and which remain gaps. backend_independent lists cases whose mapped tests open no storage backend; the gate reports them as backend_independent on PostgreSQL with the stated reason, never as a PostgreSQL pass.

AC02.note: Shared with #321 (PV-04 plan: AC02 shared #321). Two selected records, labeled sanitized evidence and content-free audit.

AC05.note: Shared with #321. Covers a corrupt envelope, key loss, audit-time denial and a failed audit append at the authorized and finished stages.

CL01.note: Body and nested metadata values, plus metadata keys, nested keys and speaker display fields on the single and fast batch paths (test_CL01_metadata_keys_and_display_fields, matched by name).

ER07.note: Current ledger applied before serving, including a forged artifact checkpoint. The snapshot-only case is the missing and foreign ledger refusals in test_same_lineage_restore_applies_current_ledger_before_recovery: the checkpoint serialized in the snapshot is not accepted as authority, restore and native open are refused, and no native copy is served. Rolling back both a snapshot and its independent ledger is outside the claim.

backend_independent.EM01: Fixed AES-256-GCM CAVP vectors, a whole-envelope vector and independent-library decryption run on the crypto module alone; no storage backend is opened.
backend_independent.EM06: Local public writer, grant, lease, expiry and audit ordering are custody and capability logic in the privacy runtime; the tests open no storage backend. Stored-evidence diagnostic reads on PostgreSQL are covered by AC02 (test_EM03_real_ciphertext_storage_and_private_diagnostic).
backend_independent.AC05: Envelope tamper, key loss and audit-time denial are crypto, custody and audit logic; the mapped tests open no storage backend. The PostgreSQL stored-evidence read path is covered by AC02.
